portInfo.description: A iconic American port city known for the Golden Gate Bridge, hills, and cultural diversity.

climate.description: Mediterranean climate with cool summers and mild winters

politics.visaRequirements: Visa-free for citizens of Visa Waiver Program countries (ESTA required). Others need visa.
politics.entryRequirements: Valid passport required. ESTA required for visa-free countries. Some nationalities need visa.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Pier 27 James R. Herman Cruise Terminal — Pier 27, The Embarcadero, San Francisco (northern waterfront)
gettingThere.distanceToCity: BART/Muni. ~20 min walk Embarcadero station to Pier 27; streetcar Embarcadero/Sansome. Pier 35. Embarcadero/Bay Street stop. Piers 30/32. Embarcadero/Brannan; ~20 min walk from Ferry Building. Parking. Not at terminals; Metropolis 55 & 80 Francisco Street per Port courtesy note.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Confirm local transport options with the ship on your call date.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Embarcadero / Ferry Building — walkable from Pier 27 with time — ~90 min.
Fisherman’s Wharf / Pier 39 — north; confirm distance vs Pier 35 assignment.
Cable cars / Union Square — hills; longer call.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Confirm Pier 27 vs 35 vs 30/32 before rideshare — they are not interchangeable walking distances.
